question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks and make the sentence meaningful.**

The _______ from my window is of the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** ‘scene; sea.’**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The sentence implies that there is a sea outside the window. One can see the sea from the window.
 
• From the given sentence it is clear that both the blanks will be filled in by nouns.
 
• **Seen and see** are verbs.
 
• We can easily eliminate the options.
 
• Only option (3) consists of two nouns **‘scene’ **and **‘sea.’**
 
• **Scene** (दृश्य): a specific view or setting. (एक विशिष्ट दृश्य या सेटिंग)
 
 
• **Example**: *The sunset created a breathtaking **scene**__ over the mountains.*
 
 
 
• **Sea **(समुंदर): a large body of saltwater; ocean. (खारे पानी का एक बड़ा भंडार; महासागर)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The **sea**__ was calm and beautiful on a sunny day.*
 
 
 
• Hence, **‘scene’ and ‘sea’ **will be the most appropriate to fill the blanks.
 
• The correct answer is **option 3.**

**Correct sentence**: *The __**scene**__ from my window is of the __**sea**__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **See** (देखना): is a verb that means to perceive something with the eyes, to observe or witness.

 
 
• **Example**: I can see a beautiful rainbow in the sky.
 
 
 
• (Scene and Seen), (See and Sea) are Homonyms.
 
• **Homonym: **Same sound but different meaning.
